# Signed history rewrite map

On 2026-08-30, the 172 unpublished `main` commits after signed remote base
`cf45e9b794ef39de4d5a8cbc8f28d3dee0f315d3` were rewritten solely to add GPG
commit signatures. For every mapped commit, the tree, commit message, author
identity/date, committer identity/date, and parent topology were preserved;
parent object IDs changed only where an unpublished parent was likewise signed.

Every replacement signature verifies against fingerprint
`3068C88C61756A2D772F8C3D84A0F71707AE3AB8`. The original tip
`0f8ea7ea05fe0c5a5aae5b2be906fb7f63f350b0` remains recoverable through
`refs/backup/deepwyrm-pre-sign-main-20260830-0f8ea7e`. Its signed same-tree
replacement is `ea29132f6b21fb89b1d1d9be63a18c6dbc287ece`.

Historical validation and evidence files intentionally retain a pre-sign
identity when that identity is part of the request, receipt, artifact path, or
provenance bytes originally accepted. Use this map to resolve those identities
to the canonical signed history; do not rewrite immutable evidence.
